chunks: Everything in it that is from Al-Faḍl ibn ʿAbd al-Malik, I have narrated from my father—may Allah be pleased with him—from Saʿd ibn ʿAbd Allah, from Muḥammad ibn al-Ḥusayn ibn Abī al-Khaṭṭāb, from Jaʿfar ibn Bashīr, from Ḥammād ibn ʿUthmān, from Al-Faḍl ibn ʿAbd al-Malik, known as Abū al-ʿAbbās al-Baqbāq al-Kūfī.

key_terms.الْبَقْبَاقِ: the narrator’s well-known epithet or nickname
key_terms.الْمَعْرُوفِ بِأَبِي الْعَبَّاسِ: known by the kunyah Abū al-ʿAbbās
key_terms.رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ: an honorific supplication meaning 'may Allah be pleased with him'

ai.seo_question: What is the transmission chain to Al-Faḍl ibn ʿAbd al-Malik in Man Lā Yaḥḍuruhu al-Faqīh?
ai.summary: This passage clarifies the sanad/isnad through which the author transmits reports from Al-Faḍl ibn ʿAbd al-Malik. It serves as a chain-authentication note in Man Lā Yaḥḍuruhu al-Faqīh, identifying the intermediaries and the narrator’s known epithet and origin.
